tool.description: Read 1D barcodes from an image (PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/BMP) and return every detected code as JSON with format and text. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call. Params: format=auto|ean-13|ean-8|upc-a|code-128|code-39 (default auto tries common 1D symbologies including UPC-E, Code 93, Codabar, ITF), try_harder=true|false (default true for tougher scans). This tool is 1D-only; use qr-decode for QR codes.

format.description: Barcode symbology to decode. auto (default) tries common 1D formats (EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A/UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, ITF); choose a specific format to reduce false positives. QR and other 2D codes are out of scope — use qr-decode for QR.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

try_harder.description: Spend extra effort scanning rotations and harder binarizations. Default true; set false for faster decoding of clean, straight scans.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
